calls.statement:
SELECT m.home_store_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows, min(join_date), max(join_date)
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) OR m.home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS total_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS cur_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to='9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)) AS no_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dupe_keys,
 max(valid_from) AS max_valid_from
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
WITH tampere_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900
),
cur AS (
  SELECT member_id, home_store_id, join_date FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere_stores)
),
ever AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tampere_stores)
),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cur) AS current_home_tampere,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM ever) AS ever_home_tampere,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM active)) AS current_tampere_active_52w,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE join_date > DATE '2026-10-04') AS future_join,
       (SELECT string_agg(CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), ',') FROM tampere_stores) AS stores

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS loyalty_members_in_tampere
FROM dim_member m
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
